purpose: Sprig reference for image-guided retexturing in Tripo; no changes to model, rig or runtime art
prompt:
Create ONE polished FULL BODY FRONT VIEW TEXTURING REFERENCE IMAGE of SPRIG, a green leaf spirit for the Bloomlings mobile game, for use in Tripo image-guided retexturing of an EXISTING 3D mesh.

The FIRST supplied image is the actual current 3D model and locks its identity, proportions, face, leaf arrangement and recognizable asymmetrical leaf quiff. The SECOND image is the approved character design and provides the preferred clean stylized material/color direction and T-pose. Preserve the actual character: large softly rounded-square head, tiny plump body and short limbs, large warm dark brown eyes with cream whites, subtle small button nose, delicate green brows, happy open mouth with small pink tongue, soft peach-pink cheek blush. Restore a neutral straight upright T-POSE, short arms extended horizontally to the sides, palms facing forward, EXACTLY FOUR DIGITS on each hand (three short rounded fingers and a thumb), feet separated by a small clear gap. Preserve the dominant diagonally swept pointed leaf over the forehead, the few supporting leaves, two little cheek leaves, and the two overlapping V-shaped chest leaves. Keep the same proportions and geometry language; do not invent clothes, extra props, extra leaf layers or a different face.

TEXTURE AND MATERIAL TARGET:
- Body and face: luminous LIGHT CREAM-PISTACHIO GREEN with a gentle warm ivory undertone, the same continuous natural skin material from face to body and limbs. Soft restrained peach blush. Clean smooth MATTE / SATIN surface, never wet, greasy, metallic or glossy plastic. Avoid the shiny white patches visible on the first model render. No pores, noise, spots, grain or fur. Preserve warm cream-green color without turning the whole face into lemon yellow, neon lime or white.
- Leaves: clear rich SPRING GREEN, medium green at roots and softly lighter fresh green edges; a restrained two-tone painterly color transition. Large clean rounded sculpted planes, one simple shallow center crease and at most a couple very broad subtle stylized folds. No realistic branched veins, ribbing, corrugation, thin botanical detail, mottling, transparency or photographic leaf texture. Keep the approved swept tapered shapes, not a round leaf wreath or broccoli. Leaf color should harmonize with the pale pistachio skin while remaining clearly greener and richer.
- Feet: same skin-family material with softly deeper green toe color as in the source, clean gentle gradient, no footwear additions.
- Eyes: crisp dark chocolate irises with warm brown lower rim, deep pupils, clean cream sclera and ONE small tasteful designed bright catchlight per eye; no large smeared white reflections. Mouth interior warm dark brown-red with a small coral-pink tongue. Facial features sharp and readable on a phone.
- Cohesive high quality stylized game art, simple clean color areas, no realistic plant material.

LIGHTING IS IMPORTANT FOR TEXTURING: broad diffuse neutral evenly balanced studio illumination from both sides, minimal mild form shading only, as close to clean albedo as possible while retaining readable three-dimensional shape. No dramatic directional shadows, dark ambient-occlusion stains between leaves, bloom, glow, colored rim light, mirror highlights, baked spotlight gradients or strong ground shadow. Pure WHITE background with no labels, color chips, grids, props, decorative scene or text. One complete unclipped front-facing character, generous white margins, no side/rear views or UV atlas. This is a clean beauty reference to guide recoloring the owner's existing model, not a redesign.
